text_block_list.text:
Late April, with lush green leaves swaying 
on cherry trees—in Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou, are you there? ...Are you 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees! I'm keeping up properlyyy~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah... Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the journey, you've 
constantly... checked in on me with such 
thoughtful words...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I barely got lost or took 
the wrong train at all to get here~...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It's only normal to look out 
for the person you're with.

Today, the three of us—myself, Admire 
Vega, and Meisho Doto—came to Kyoto 
Racecourse to watch the races.

Spectating, or... if I were to borrow 
"her" words, attending the theater.

We were here at the invitation of the girl 
who called herself the 'leading lady' of 
this race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The lead role, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even in a race like this, where the 
defining Umamusume of an era gather to vie 
for the Emperor's Shield, she can still 
say such things—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It really is just like you, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's almost refreshing.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Raise your chalice. Let blessings be 
poured. Fill it to the brim with joy. Let 
wonder overflow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Sing, birds! Shine, sun! Earth, sprout 
forth beneath my feet!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —A 'new chapter' begins.
(W-WAAAAAAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what, really!? This is the part 
where everyone goes wild!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't know!! I mean, I have no 
clue!! But somehow—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Like... you know. I don't really get it, 
but like...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-chan――

Triumphantly humming a tune, yet 
forcefully projecting a sheer certainty to 
everyone around that she was "definitely 
up to something."

Ridiculously refreshing, and wonderfully 
steadfast, she headed into the actual 
race—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They've just turned into the home 
straight! Is Narita Top Road holding a 
slight lead!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O! TM Opera O rapidly closes the 
gap! TM Opera O surges straight into the 
lead!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Daaaaamn itttttttt!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes TM Opera O! Here comes TM Opera 
O! Is Narita Top Road in second place?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Number 2 is surging from the outside! But 
it's T.M. Opera O! It's T.M. Opera O!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O in the lead, crosses the 
finish line!! She's done it! T.M. Opera 
O!!
(UWAAAAAAAHH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... aaah... aaaaah... Opera O-san... 
Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (What kind of race are you running...?!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!! I trust you all enjoyed 
this opening act of genesis!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: However, from here on out—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A solo won't do. A duo won't cut it 
either. Even a trio is not enough.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You know, don't you? No, you knew all 
along, didn't you? It's you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"It's you. You, and only you, are the one 
I've been waiting for."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Me, me, me, me...

...On the way back, Meisho Doto seemed 
lost in thought, walking in silence. 
Without hesitating or taking a wrong turn 
even once.
And so, upon arriving back at the Academy—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much for today! Um... Um, 
so, um um...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, that's all for me!! E-Excuse me, 
please!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, hah--

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haff, haff, ...haaah, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I... I am... I want to... Even someone 
like me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll... Opera O's...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Look at her... not even changing clothes. 
...Is that just her being clumsy too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I'll change my clothes, but... 
...I, too—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Mind if I go for a quick run?

"Her eyes still fixed on Meisho Doto 
sprinting in her school uniform, Admire 
Vega murmured those words quietly, 
snap-pulling me back to my senses."

It's not that I won't let go, but that I 
cannot. In those eyes lies unmistakable—

Because I saw a throbbing ache in her— an 
overwhelming desire to run right this 
instant.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

Surrendering herself to her impulses, 
Admire Vega dashes off.

Her tail fluttering as it gleamed in the 
sunlight, and her form silhouetted in 
orange light.

Everything about her back then was so 
vividly, beautifully alive and dynamic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan... What an amazing run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I came in... third, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Arrrgh, no no no, this won't do at all! 
All right...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to...! Grow even more, just you 
watch...!!
